[[File:Selection-Monster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ventress faces six Nightbrothers during her Selection's Test of Fury.]]
The '''Test of Fury''' was the first in a series of trials that the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] and [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] were forced to pass to go on to become warriors or [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] in full. The Test of Fury primarily involved combat, with candidates either being pitted against each other or their instructor, the latter of which was the case when [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] faced off with six Nightbrother clan leaders during her [[Selection/Legends|Selection]].
